description: This file is a shell script for automating and managing the process of resolving merge conflicts in git. It includes functions for handling symlinks, submodules, temp directories, and invoking merge tools, as well as logic for processing merge conflicts and user interactions.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Returns true if the mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Returns true if the mode indicates a submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if local_mode variable is set (non-empty).

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if remote_mode variable is set (non-empty).

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if base_mode variable is set (non-empty).

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes temporary directory for merge by creating a temp dir or defaulting to current directory.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files, optionally backing up original merge data.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Provides a description of the file state based on its mode.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving symbolic links by asking the user to choose local or remote.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving deleted files, allowing user to choose whether to keep or delete.

methods.name: resolve_submodule_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving submodules with options for local or remote resolution.

methods.name: stage_submodule
methods.description: Stages a submodule after resolving conflict, updating index accordingly.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a staged file into a working directory snapshot.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Uses git merge-file to produce resolved versions of conflicting files.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function to process a merge conflict for a specific file, invoke merge tools, and handle special cases.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Prompts user whether to continue after a failed merge.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Outputs message indicating no files need merging and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point, parsing arguments, initializing environment, and orchestrating the merging process for all conflicted files.
